calendar.title: What's live, ending, or coming back.
calendar.intro: Every date below is either a live status we're watching right now, or a real estimate — from our own tracked history, or a few researched, published patterns where our own tracking (started 2026-08-04) doesn't have enough of a record yet. Never a guess with nothing behind it.
calendar.liveNowEmpty: Nothing limited-time is live right now.
calendar.estimatedToEndEmpty: No live event has enough history yet for an estimate.
calendar.typicallyReturnsEmpty: No ended event has enough history yet to estimate a return.
calendar.metaDescription: When ModeAlert's tracked limited-time modes and events are expected to end, and when the ended ones typically come back — based on real tracked history and, where researched, published historical patterns.
